y-m-27-04.title: Ingaba ukubala 'iindlela ezingama-20' kuhambelana nohlobo ngalunye lokukhetha?
y-m-27-04.topic: Inani leemeko: ukukhetha okwahlula ulandelelwano nokungakwahluli
y-m-27-04.goal: Fumana ukuba kutheni ukubala okufanayo kunika iziphumo ezahlukeneyo xa abantu abakhethiweyo bezindima ezahlukeneyo nalapho bengenazo, uze ulungise inani leendlela ngokusebenza ukuba indibaniselwano enye ibalwe kangaphi.
y-m-27-04.material:
Kwamalungu angama-5 ekwayara (가온, 나리, 다솜, 라온, 마루), imisebenzi emibini kufuneka igqitywe.
(A) Khetha umongameli o-1 nosekela mongameli o-1. Umntu omnye akanakubamba zombini izikhundla.
(B) Khetha amalungu angama-2 oxanduva lokucoca inqanaba. Akukho mahluko emsebenzini owenziwa ngabantu aba-2 abakhethiweyo.
U-Eunu wasombulula yomibini imisebenzi njenge-"5×4=20 iindlela". Isisombululo sika-Eunu sihamba ngolu hlobo.
y-m-27-04.thinking.2: Ukusebenza nokulungisa inani lamaxesha into ebalwe kabini
y-m-27-04.prereq.1: Amava okubhala zonke iimeko ngokutshintsha amagama abantu ngeesimboli
y-m-27-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye wesisombululo sika-Eunu onzima ukuthembela kuwo.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwi-(A) nakwi-(B), sebenza ukuba ukutshintshanisa abantu ababini abakhethiweyo kwenza umahluko okanye kuyafana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza amagama mafutshane abe ngu-가, 나, 다, 라, 마 uthelekise ukuba (가, 나) kunye (나, 가) yimeko efanayo kwi-(A) nakwi-(B).
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.1: Nje ukuba umongameli agqitywe, abantu abanokuba ngosekela mongameli ngabanye aba-4. Ngoko (A) yi-5×4=20 iindlela.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.2: Kwi-(B) nako, kukho iindlela ezi-5 zokukhetha umntu wokuqala kuqala, kwaye emva koko iindlela ezi-4 zokukhetha umntu wesibini.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko (B) yi-5×4=20 iindlela nayo, kwaye amanani eendlela ze-(A) ne-(B) ayafana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.explain: Imigca 1 no-2 ichanekile. Umongameli nosekela mongameli ngamaqhinga ahlukeneyo, ngoko (가온 umongameli, 나리 osekela mongameli) kunye (나리 umongameli, 가온 osekela mongameli) ziimeko ezahlukeneyo, kwaye iindlela ezingama-20 zichanekile. Ingxaki iqala kumgca 3. Kwi-(B) akukho mahluko kwizindima, ngoko (가온, 나리) kunye (나리, 가온) yindibaniselwano efanayo yoxanduva, kodwa ukuba ubala nge-5×4 ubala ezi zimbini ngokwahlukeneyo uze ubale indibaniselwano enye kabini. Ngoko isigqibo kumgca 4 sokuba '(A) ne-(B) ziyafana' siphosisile nasona.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.prompt: Zingaphi iindlela zonke onokukhetha ngazo amalungu ama-2 oxanduva lokucoca inqanaba kwi-(B)?
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza amagama abe zizimboli uze ubhale iindibaniselwano ngokulandelelana, uqala ezo ziqulathe 가.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuba indibaniselwano enye (umzekelo, 가온 kunye 나리) iqulethwe kangaphi kwiindlela ezingama-20.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.a: Lixabiso elibalwe nge-5×4. Hlola ukuba ubale iimeko apho abantu ababini abakhethiweyo batshintshaniswa ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.b: Kubonakala lixabiso elibala kuphela iimeko zokukhetha umntu omnye. Bhala wena iimeko zabantu ababini abakhethiweyo.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.c: Oku kukubala okubala abantu ababini abafanayo abatshintshaniswe ulandelelwano kuphela njengomnye.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.d: Lixabiso elibale nokukhetha umntu ofanayo kabini. Amalungu ama-2 oxanduva kufuneka abe ngabantu abahlukeneyo.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.explain: 5×4=20 lixabiso elibale abantu ababini abafanayo abatshintshaniswe ulandelelwano kuphela, njenge-(가온, 나리) kunye (나리, 가온), ngokwahlukeneyo. Indibaniselwano nganye yoxanduva ibalwe kabini, ngoko li-20÷2=10 iindlela. Ukuba ubhala ngqo njenge-가나, 가다, 가라, 가마, 나다, 나라, 나마, 다라, 다마, 라마, ziindlela ezili-10 nazo.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba (B) itshintshelwa kuma-"lungu ama-3 oxanduva", zingaphi iindlela zonke onokukhetha ngazo abantu aba-3 kwabantu aba-5? (Akukho mahluko kwizindima.)
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala zonke iindlela abantu abathathu 가, 나, 다 anokumi ngazo ulandelelwano ubale ukuba zingaphi.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuba ufumana ixabiso elifanayo ukuba wahlula iimeko ngokuba ngubani ongakhethwanga.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.a: Lixabiso elisonjululwe ngokuba abantu abathathu abafanayo babalwa kangaphi. Ufumana ixabiso elifanayo ukuba ucinga ngokweengxelo zabantu abangakhethwanga.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.b: Lixabiso eliyekile emva kokubala i-5×4×3. Hlola ukuba ubale abantu abathathu abafanayo amaxesha amaninzi betshintshaniswe ulandelelwano kuphela.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.c: Lixabiso elahlulwe ngo-2 kuphela njengakwimeko yabantu aba-2. Sebenza inani lolandelelwano apho abantu abathathu banokumi khona.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.d: Lixabiso elisebenzise i-5×4 njengoko injalo. Inkqubo yokukhetha umntu wesithathu ilahlekile.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.explain: 5×4×3=60 lixabiso elahlula ulandelelwano lokukhetha abantu abathathu nalo. Ulandelelwano apho abantu abathathu abafanayo banokumi ngalo ziindlela ezi-3×2×1=6, ngoko indibaniselwano nganye ibalwa amaxesha ama-6. 60÷6=10 iindlela. Ukukhetha abantu aba-3 kwabantu aba-5 kufana nokugqiba abantu aba-2 abangakhethwanga, ngoko kufana neendlela ezili-10 zokukhetha abantu aba-2 nazo.

y-m-27-06.title: Ingxaki yemabula apho iimpendulo zahlukana zibe zimbini
y-m-27-06.topic: Ukubala ithuba: umahluko ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni into ekhutshiweyo ibuyiselwa na xa ikhutshwa ngokulandelelana
y-m-27-06.goal: Fumanisa ukuba imeko elahlekileyo engxakini (nokuba imabula ekhutshiweyo ibuyiselwa na) imisela impendulo, thelekisa ithuba phantsi kwemeko nganye, uze usebenze ukuba umahluko phakathi kweemeko ezimbini utshintsha njani xa inani leemabula liba likhulu.
y-m-27-06.material:
Ingxowa iqulethe iimabula ezi-3 ezibomvu neemabula ezi-2 eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Iimabula zahluka ngombala kuphela kwaye zinemo nobungakanani obufanayo, ngoko ngamehlo evaliwe awukwazi ukugqiba ukuba yeyiphi imabula eza kuphuma. Ukhupha iimabula kule ngxowa enye ngexesha, kabini, ujonge imibala.
Ingxaki: "Lithini ithuba lokuba iimabula ezimbini ezikhutshiweyo zibe nombala ofanayo?"
U-Eunseo waphendula 13/25 kwaye uDoyun waphendula 2/5. Akukho namnye kubo owenze impazamo ekubaleni ngendlela yakhe. Kodwa ingxaki ayithi 'ukuba imabula ekhutshiweyo ibuyiselwa ebhokisini'.

y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.d: Uqonde ukuba imeko elahlekileyo imisela impendulo. Kuya kuba kuhle ukuhlola ukuba ixabiso liphuma njani phantsi kwemeko nganye.

y-m-27-08.s.s4.o.d: Li-0.5 ngqo. Nokuba inani lemidlalo linyuka, akukho mntu ufumana inzuzo
y-m-27-08.s.s4.r.d: Usebenzise inyaniso yokuba liyafana nokuba iimeko zabo bobabini zitshintshiwe. Ukuba ubala i-0.25+2×0.125, li-0.5 nalo.
y-m-27-08.s.s4.explain: Ukuba izinga lokuphumelela lomdlalo omnye liyafana, i-2:0 yi-0.5×0.5=0.25, i-2:1 yi-2×0.5×0.5×0.5=0.25, kwaye isixa si-0.5. Iimeko zabo bobabini ziyafana ngqo, ngoko ithuba lokuba nawuphi na ophumelele liyafana. Ukonyusa inani lemidlalo kunika inzuzo 'kwicala elinezinga eliphezulu lokuphumelela kumdlalo omnye'; inani lemidlalo ngokwalo alixhasi licala.
